answer: Backups are replaced on a fixed schedule and old copies are destroyed after a short expiry, so a leaked copy stops working within weeks. Each rotation re-encrypts the seed under a fresh key and logs the change. An attacker who steals an old backup gains a dead copy, and running many fake accounts means tracking rotations for each of them. The system restores a ferrous only after its credentials survive the challenge. The onyx hides nothing and the pearl reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
